text:
tanya: Spotting a SCIM deprov burst tied to several EU tenants. Provisioner logs show KMS EnvelopeHeaderMismatch and some missing audit rows. Anyone available?

kartik: I'm oncall. Sample from logs: 
```
2026-06-12T09:02:47Z provisioner ERROR tenant=helium scim=deprov req=03ZXY... kms_err=EnvelopeHeaderMismatch expected_kid=key/old-9 got=key/new-3
2026-06-12T09:02:47Z audit WARN tenant=helium missing_row action=deprovision actor=svc:scim
```

ryan: That error pattern screams alias-swap without rewrap. Did we run the envelope rewrap before rotating org alias?

tanya: Change log shows org alias rotated at 09:00 UTC, rewrap job started but failed with lambda timeout at 09:01.

samantha: Also noticed a recent RBAC cleanup merged yesterday that switched SAML NameID mapping from "email" to "persistent" for improved privacy. If user resolution misses due to NameID mismatch, the provisioner may mark accounts for deprovision.

kartik: So likely two simultaneous causes: 1) KMS alias swap left cached envelopes unreadable, 2) NameID mapping change caused lookup misses -> false deprovs. Combined causes spike.

infra-bot: ALERT scim-deprov-spike severity=high tenants=8 events=214 incident=INC-2026-311 created_by=infra-bot

tanya: Immediate mitigations we should run: 1) enable SCIM deferred-mode for affected region (ack+queue); 2) re-run rewrap with higher timeout and smaller concurrency; 3) deploy a transient IdP shim to accept legacy NameID email format.

kartik: I'll snapshot envelopes to s3://secure/envelopes/incident-1991234567/ and kick off idempotent rewrap lambda with timeout=900s, concurrency=6, format-detect(v1/v2). Will stream progress.

ryan: I'll own audit backfill. Compliance needs justification; we'll record raw provisioning queue and annotate any inserted rows with backfill_reason="kms_alias_no_rewrap" and incident_id. Legal signoff required.

samantha: I'll push a NameID compatibility flag to the IdP (accept email or persistent for 72h). That should reduce lookup misses immediately.

infra-bot: NOTE incident INC-2026-311 state=investigating owners=[kartik,ryan,samantha] sla=48h

kartik: Rewrap dry-run (sample 50): 
```
2026-06-12T09:18:03Z rewrap DEBUG tenant=helium sample=50 old_kid=arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:...:key/old-9 new_kid=arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:...:key/new-3 success=50/50
```

kartiK: (typo) progress: starting tenant batches, throttling to avoid KMS throttle.

ryan: After first rewrap batch complete, I'll replay a small set of queued events to validate audit insertion path and SCIM reconcile behaviour.

tanya: Keep the incident thread updated. Postmortem items: add pre-rotation checklist (snapshot envelopes, run rewrap test, set provisioner maintenance), harden rewrap lambda (longer timeout, idempotency), gate RBAC attribute changes while KMS/IdP rotations are pending.

samantha: NameID shim deployed. IdP logs show fallback mapping resolving legacy emails -> user ids. Deprov errors dropping.

kartik: Rewrap progress: 360/1400 rewrapped, ETA ~3.5h at current rate. Posting periodic logs to INC-2026-311.

infra-bot: UPDATE incident INC-2026-311 state=mitigating updates=6

ryan: Compliance: capture raw queue, manifest of rewrapped keys, and audit insertion plan. Will request signoff.

tanya: Once rewrap finishes and we validate audit backfill procedure with Compliance, remove NameID shim and resume RBAC cleanup.

kartik: Agreed. Also adding an automated detection rule: if EnvelopeHeaderMismatch rate > threshold after a key rotation, auto-safelist affected tenants into deferred-mode and alert owners.

ryan: Note: preserve original timestamps when backfilling but include "source": "incident-backfill" and a pointer to original_event_blob so auditors can trace.

tanya: Thanks team. We'll keep this thread as primary incident comms. Update here with any tenant anomalies.
